newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 26.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Six-month shutdown of Superphenix superbreeder from December 24 underscores the reactor's failure after nine years of development work and waning interest in nuclear community.
-- Alain Geniteau tops list of activists who use a handful of shares to wage war with big corporations.

Hopes fading for agreement on change in legal status for Airbus by end-year. French officials say privately they back the idea of turning the aircraft partnership into an integrated company but not at any price.
